name: pishogue
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Pishoguery is an old Irish word for magic of the eye. It means a spell that makes the world seem changed. People say a sight is pishogue when it is only a trick. The word still means a false distraction. It keeps the old idea of glamour.

okr.objective: Define pishogue as an Irish spell of illusion.
key_results: Pishogue makes the world seem changed.
People call a false sight a pishogue.
